title: potentiomap: potentiometric surfaces in R
text: Built-methods inverse-distance weighting (IDW), thin-plate splines (TPS), ordinary kriging (OK), universal kriging (UK) quadratic drift. Named user functions also supported. IDW deterministic distance based. TPS produces smooth penalized surface. OK assumes constant unknown mean requires usable variogram. UK uses specified quadratic spatial trend requires estimable, adequately conditioned design. TPS remains software default backward compatibility produces smooth surface. suitability evaluated monitoring network, hydrogeologic setting, prediction support, validation design, intended map use. Requested methods never silently replaced.

text: Set return = "result" retain method conditions, fitted model information, grid geometry, observation counts, optional support products. kriging, result includes empirical fitted variogram information. UK, also includes trend rank, condition number, coordinate scaling, prediction-range diagnostics. TPS records supported GCV selection information. ps_prediction_support() classifies cells using training-point convex hull, nearest-observation distance, mask membership, finite prediction availability. convex hull describes monitoring network; aquifer boundary. Finite predictions outside training network can still poorly supported.
